# Data absent
- `9606.protein.links.full.v12.0.txt.gz`: All protein-protein links from STRINGdb in humans, from v12.0, downloaded 8 January, 2025.
- `9606.protein.aliases.v12.0.txt`: Mapping file for human proteins in STRINGdb, from v12.0, downloaded 19 September, 2025. Used to map ENSP IDs (used in STRINGdb) to ENSG IDs.
